# MyLab technology logos

Brand assets used solely to identify the technologies in the case study; no endorsement implied. All trademarks belong to their owners. Local copies avoid runtime CDN dependencies.

Dashboard Icons collection: https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons (Apache-2.0; see LICENSE-dashboard-icons.txt). containerd: CNCF artwork. Sealed Secrets: project documentation wordmark (includes embedded PNG). Calico: Tigera brand icon. Logos are displayed without changing their artwork or colors.
